# Daily Sticky

Daily Sticky is a free, mobile-first digital sticker journal web app.

It helps people document their year by choosing one sticker per day on a calendar. Users can also add short notes to remember what happened, how they felt, or what mattered that day.

Daily Sticky is designed for people who want to journal but do not want a traditional journaling routine. It is simple, visual, low-pressure, and private.

## Main Pages

- [Home](https://dailysticky.app/)
- [About](https://dailysticky.app/about.html)
- [Sticky Notes Blog](https://dailysticky.app/blog/)
- [View Daily Notes](https://dailysticky.app/notes.html)

## Key Features

- Pick one sticker per day
- View stickers on a monthly calendar
- View a full year of stickers
- Add short daily notes
- View all saved notes in one place
- Share a weekly sticker recap
- Export and import backup data

## Privacy

Daily Sticky stores journal data locally on the user's device using browser storage. Stickers and notes are not uploaded to a server by Daily Sticky.

Users are responsible for exporting backups if they want to preserve their data across devices or browser changes.

## Best Description

Daily Sticky is a calendar-based sticker journal for people who want to remember their year without writing long journal entries.
